'''Brionelle''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] of the [[Chandrilan Security Force]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Brionelle served as the commander of the [[Chandrila Orbital Station]]. Admiral Brionelle was killed during the Sith [[Battle of the Red Reaper|assault]] on the station. The [[Brionelle Memorial Military Academy]] was later named after Brionelle.<ref name="SoR" />
